required.name: discard.curio-primary-roll-precedence

required.name: character-overview.fits-long-blessing-names

required.name: arbiter.rejects-overlap

required.name: arbiter.releases-once

required.name: equipment.preserves-preview

required.name: equipment.bounds-retry

required.name: inventory.defers-equip-resort

required.name: inventory.repairs-invalid-material-reference

required.name: custom-tier.overrides-red-weapons-at-home

required.name: curio.rotation-waits

required.name: curio.purchase-revalidates

required.name: curio.owned-set-upgrades

required.name: curio.reads-cancel

required.name: discard.keeps-ownership

required.name: discard.fails-closed

required.name: settings.audit-localization

required.name: auto-crafter.quarantines-ambiguous-mutations

required.name: auto-crafter.blocks-external-account-writes

required.name: auto-crafter.validates-trait-mutations

required.name: auto-crafter.final-read-timeout-never-retries-mutation

required.name: auto-crafter.hud-terminal-state-converges

required.name: auto-crafter.external-interrupt-is-atomic

required.name: auto-crafter.custom-stats-are-exact-and-guarded

required.name: auto-crafter.custom-fallback-minimizes-total-distance

required.name: auto-crafter.acquisition-mode-and-dump-comparison

required.name: auto-crafter.acquisition-cap-excludes-mastery-fodder

required.name: auto-crafter.contains-frame-crashes

required.name: auto-crafter.context-exit-releases-imported-queue

required.name: auto-crafter.optional-mod-compatibility-soak

required.name: games-lantern.terminal-events-are-authoritative

required.name: games-lantern.two-job-boundaries-fail-closed
